ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (estimated >95%) with sparse high-intensity white/light-grey pixels localized primarily at the trailing edge boundary and the median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Isolated white mottling patches along the trailing edges of both lobes. Distinct high-intensity punctate clusters near the median notch. A dense, low-contrast brownish-grey textured cluster at the terminal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous small-scale serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude (3-6 pixel) peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobe trailing edges exhibit a symmetrical convex curvature sweeping upward and outward from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, dense cluster of circular, high-contrast textured pixels at the tip of the right lobe consistent with sessile organism colonization. Scattered white circular spots across the mid-region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-grey linear streaks with non-uniform orientations visible on the dark background of the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of biofouling/barnacles at the distal tip of the right lobe, creating an irregular, thickened edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water droplets and filaments shedding vertically from multiple points along the trailing edge of the fluke.
